schema.direction: Owned F2A202: method19 -> bounded-face topology; method14 ->90055 explicit native origin-plane identity; method13 ->90055 explicit source-sketch identity. Descriptor103, owner191, reciprocal support179.
schema.position_support: Owned69EE178: method17 selects bounded-face recipe; method6 selects face recipe; method12 selects explicit origin-plane identity; method10 source-point identities are delegated to existing point reader. Descriptor79, owner167, support155.
schema.AtCenter: Distinct method5 center provider selects an edge recipe, while its position method6 selects a face. The axis method19 independently selects a bounded-face recipe. Same historical body anchor is checked; no coordinates choose topology identities.
schema.extent: Sequential cursor follows optional input fields through TipAngle; u32 native extent-selection count0 for Distance,1 for ToEntity/ThroughAll, explicit proxy references,20zero bytes, body-input count1 and body proxy. ToEntity proxy selects face_recipe_data; ThroughAll selects body_recipe_data via existing body decoder.
schema.core: Owned3CDCCC has u32 context count1/3 and that many C46D namespace contexts, reciprocal support entries referencing active native inputs. Count agrees with saved placement count; no context-to-position identity assignment inferred. Core is not the selected target.
schema.metadata: Valid stored metadata UUID retained. Ordinary captured holes use nil UUID; tapped holes have a nonzero UUID, whose meaning remains unresolved.

evidence_limits: Original API truth captures Hole position, direction, extent class and numeric settings, not post-creation face/plane/target selection entity getters. Role interpretation uses controlled saved generator calls plus typed native framing and reciprocal references.

GenerateHoleSamples.setPositionByPoint(seed.endFaces.item(0),...) and setOneSideToExtent(seed.startFaces.item(0),False) establish support/target roles. No source recipe is identified as an exact geometric end/start face in production.
GenerateHolePlacements uses the explicit XY plane for reversed cases, a face-supported HoleLocations sketch for sketch-point cases and setPositionAtCenter(top,top.edges.item(0)) for AtCenter.
GenerateTappedHoles calls setPositionByPoint on an extrusion end face. Position backend normalizes to method6 rather than the method17 stored by earlier ordinary holes.
ThroughAll has an internal native body extent input. The API setAllExtent call has no user-selected target argument, so this body is not presented as an explicit user selection.
B0B103 center-edge context is retained opaque. It does not establish a circle equation, selected BRep edge identity or regeneration.
